correctness.rationale: The finite tree-to-rooted-forest bijection is exact for each n,d. Lagrange inversion gives G=N^{-(N-d-1)} D_N^{N-d-1}t^{d-1}. The root-preservation lemma is proved by a direct logarithmic derivative, tracking every pole, zero multiplicity, and leading coefficient when deg(f)<N. Exchangeable polarization gives a real-stable multiaffine joint PGF and the established strong Rayleigh implication. Explicit two-indicator factorial moments show strictly negative covariance except degenerate classes. Standalone exact tests: 27,106 passed, with exhaustive Prüfer words for n<=8, moment identities through n<=50, pair covariance through n<=100, and Sturm counts through n<=16. Computation is corroboration, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The local leaf-neighbor frequency is naturally motivated as a degree-conditioned branching statistic of the canonical finite uniform labeled tree. All-size Poisson-binomial and negative-association statements govern the full law and every disjoint subcollection, supplying more than marginal count formulas or a finite table. The structural real-rootedness lemma yields exact finite-sample distributional tools; no claimed generalization to weighted graphs, nor unproved application, is needed for value.
